name: Being Scared
overview: Scripture teaches that believers can overcome fear by trusting in God's constant presence and guidance. God promises to go before us and never forsake us, encouraging strength and courage in His abiding presence (Deuteronomy 31:8; Joshua 1:9). The Lord, as our shepherd, provides for our needs and directs our path through His Word, which serves as a lamp to guide us in times of uncertainty (Psalms 23:1; Psalms 119:105). Therefore, trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding is key to facing fear with confidence (Proverbs 3:5).
